verdict.rationale: restate-docs-24 explicitly documents that Restate ensures invocations start and end on the same service version, routing retries to the same endpoint that started them—directly addressing versioning without breaking in-flight determinism. This is reinforced by the broader durable-execution model (restate-docs-1, restate-docs-18) that persists journal state independent of code, making version-pinned resumption feasible. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific versioning behavior in production and more detail on how new deployments are rolled out alongside old versions.
